plainText:
Nicky (Japanese: クック Kukku) is a minor character appearing in and . He is the drummer for Roxie's band.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
Nicky appeared in Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 1 and Rocking the Virbank Gym! Part 2. He is a drummer playing with Roxie and Billy Jo in the band " and the Toxics", which is quite well known in Unova. He also provides music during Roxie's Gym battles. During the battle Roxie had with , he interacted with the audience several times and stirred them up so they could cheer for Roxie.

He once went on tour with the band through Kanto.

===Voice actors===
 

==In the games==
Nicky appears at the Virbank Gym in . Here, he also plays in a band with Roxie, just like in . The has to battle him before being able to battle Roxie.

Being defeated
"I'm the one who got knocked out! That was exhilarating!"

After being defeated
